notes.title: Idle Run Aya V1.1
notes.content:
💙 Idle Run Aya – Patch Notes v1.1🚀 Performance & Technical Improvements
The pedometer no longer updates in real time, but at intervals – this significantly improves performance.

Additional optimizations for even smoother gameplay.

Scrolling behavior fixed.

More measures added to prevent "out of bounds" bugs.

Minor sound fixes included.
[hr][/hr]🐾 New Content & Features
New pets added – more than 6 cute companions await!

Butterfly click mechanic introduced for extra interaction (optional).

Secret bonus level added – can you find it?

A hidden easter egg has been added.

Idle animation added – Aya now stretches occasionally when standing still.

New "Hide Front Layer" button for a cleaner view.

Random zone generator completely reworked:

Layers now match more naturally.

Includes several new layers exclusive to the generator.

Now also works at night and during rain.
[hr][/hr]🎨 Visual & UI Enhancements
Font has been changed for improved readability.

Textbox design updated.

Visual feedback for interactables:

Clickable objects now glow green.

Non-clickable objects no longer light up.

Bonus step objects now visibly marked.

End sequence now correctly displays all unlocked hair colors.
[hr][/hr]🧠 Gameplay & Balance Adjustments
Level-ups now grant a reward every time.

Buff system reworked:

Eating is now only possible at full speed.

Unusable buffs are now grayed out for better clarity.

Buffs can now be toggled individually.

Base stamina increased: from 30 to 50 – longer running without resting.
[hr][/hr]📸 Interactions & Dialogue Updates
Photographer interaction:

Clicking him now destroys his camera.

If he manages to take a photo, he will proudly hang it up.

Mood bar added:

Tracks Aya’s current state of mind.

Affects her bust-click dialogues.

Staying uncovered drains the bar – she starts confident but grows snappier over time.

Wearing clothes again refills the bar quickly.

Bust-click dialogue added to the main menu.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Miscellaneous Fixes
Various minor bug fixes and polish applied.
